name: Nip 'Em in the Bud
summary: Dark Iron spies move through Dun Morogh, and Earthseer Farsen calls for help. Near Ironband's Compound, their presence threatens the Bronzebeard homeland.

sections.title: Eyes in the Cold
sections.body: Dark Iron spies have crossed Dun Morogh's high passes and snowy crags. They hide near settlements and excavations, where even a few watchers may signal a strike. Earthseer Farsen sees the danger and calls on Alliance defenders to find them before their plans advance.

sections.title: Threat Near Ironband's Compound
sections.body: The spies gather near Ironband's Compound in eastern Dun Morogh. Earthseer Farsen does not know their purpose at first. Searching the scouts reveals an Underground Map, proof that they prepare for more than watching the area. Their plans reach toward ancient secrets below ground, including the Hall of Thanes.

faq.q: Who offers the quest Nip 'Em in the Bud?
aliases: quest giver nip em in the bud
who starts nip em in the bud
faq.answer: After you complete Farsen's Watch, Earthseer Farsen calls for aid against intruders in Dun Morogh.

faq.q: Why are Dark Iron spies in Dun Morogh?
aliases: what are dark irons doing in dun morogh
faq.answer: The Dark Iron clan schemes against its Bronzebeard cousins. Its spies watch settlements in eastern Dun Morogh and may excavate or scout buried passages near Ironband's Compound.

faq.q: Where are the Dark Iron spies located?
faq.answer: The spies gather near Ironband's Compound in eastern Dun Morogh, watching from the snowy perimeter.

aliases: what comes before nip em in the bud
nip em in the bud prequest
faq.answer: You come here after reporting for Farsen's Watch. The defenses shift from watching for intruders to hunting them.

faq.q: What is uncovered while hunting these spies?
aliases: next quest after nip em in the bud
faq.answer: The fallen spies carry a Dark Iron Map. It begins with the words “Underground Map” and points toward secrets tied to the Hall of Thanes.
Earthseer Farsen is a dwarf in Dun Morogh who watches for unusual seismic activity and hostile clan movements in the mountains.

angles.text: As a Bronzebeard dwarf, driving Dark Iron spies from your ancestral mountains means defending your home and answering old clan grudges.
As an Alliance member, stopping enemy scouts in Dun Morogh helps keep Ironforge's supply lines and nearby outposts safe from sabotage.
